name: 83202 · Chubbuck, ID
findings: ZIP 83202 (Chubbuck) has 40 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 83202 (Chubbuck) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 83202 (Chubbuck) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 38% of the typical level).
